props.name: context
props.meaning: The widget context. Every tile reads its schema, its statuses and its links through it.

props.name: thumbnail
props.meaning: Field holding the thumbnail URL. `false` leaves every tile on the placeholder.

props.name: label_field
props.meaning: Field shown as the tile's name. Defaults to the type's display name.

props.name: sub_label_field
props.meaning: The left of the metadata line. A resolved column renders it by type.

props.name: sub_label
props.meaning: The caller's own sub-label. Wins over `subLabelField`.

props.name: secondary_field
props.meaning: The right of the metadata line.

props.name: secondary
props.meaning: The caller's own text on the right. Wins over `secondaryField`.

props.name: show_code
props.meaning: Show the row's `code` beside the name when the two differ.

props.name: statuses
props.meaning: Status rows by code. Read through the context when not given.

props.name: size
props.meaning: Tile size and column minimum: 160, 224 or 288 pixels.

props.name: selectable
props.meaning: Draws a checkbox on each tile.

props.name: page_sizes
props.meaning: Rows per page offered in the footer. `pages` only.

props.name: max_height
props.meaning: Height of the scrolling body.

props.name: virtualize_after
props.meaning: Rows above which the grid draws only the tiles on screen.

props.name: empty_label
props.meaning: Shown when the read returned nothing.

props.name: error_label
props.meaning: Shown in place of what the failed read said.

props.name: density
props.meaning: Compact halves the gap between tiles.

props.name: source
props.meaning: The rows and the paging behind them.

props.name: paging
props.meaning: How the set is walked: a page number, a load-more row, or the scroller.

props.name: sort
props.meaning: The source's sort, two-way, so a SortPicker drops into `header`.

props.name: filters
props.meaning: The source's filter, two-way, so a FilterBar drops into `header`.

props.name: selection
props.meaning: The selected rows, two-way. Names loaded rows only.

props.name: get_row_id
props.meaning: How a row is keyed, in the DOM and in the selection. Default `Type:id`.

props.name: is_row_disabled
props.meaning: True for a row the arrows skip and the selection refuses.

props.name: loading_label
props.meaning: Names the skeletons a read stands behind, for a screen reader.

events.name: select
events.when: A tile was activated, by click or by Enter.

slots.name: card
slots.receives: `{ row, id, index, selected, disabled, active }`
slots.draws: Draws one grid cell. The grid keeps the cell's box, its tab stop and its keys.

keyboard.does: Moves into the grid, then out of it.
Moves the cursor one row of tiles.
Moves to the first or the last tile.

keyboard.key: Right, Down past the last tile
keyboard.does: In `more` and `scroll`, asks for the next page. The cursor stays where it is until the tiles arrive, then lands on the first of them.
Selects the tile, when the grid is selectable.
